prediction_text: Direction: Britain votes to Leave — the referendum of 23 June 2016 returns a Leave majority and the UK votes to exit the European Union, against the February poll lead for Stay. Character: a disruptive, establishment-defying result (Uranus–Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day: sudden break with the existing order), and a narrow rather than landslide margin. Coordinate: the referendum count of 23 June 2016.
basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field as such; decided from the card's own genre: the card is Jessica Adams's published mundane-astrology assessment (first published 5 July 2015, firmed 22 February 2016) citing the UK national charts and a Uranus–Ceres conjunction on referendum day, so Western mundane astrology is used.
systems_used: Western mundane astrology (national charts + referendum-day configuration)
Reasoning: the one configuration the card supplies for referendum day is Uranus conjunct Ceres in Aries — Uranus is the rupture planet, and a conjunction exact on the vote day in a cardinal fire sign reads as a sudden break from the status quo, i.e. Leave, not continuity. The assessment's own history supports firmness: published in July 2015 and firmed up the day after the date was announced, before polls had settled — it is a committed call, and its direction follows its supplied configuration. Fact check: February polls showed Stay ahead with many undecideds — a poll lead with a vast undecided bloc is exactly the factual setting in which a rupture configuration can prevail, so the polls are registered as the opposing fact, not as the call. Margin is graded narrow (undecided-heavy electorate), not a rout.
